2. Daily Log Entries

2026-09-16

Completed Today

  • Task 0.1: Repository Hygiene & Netlify CI Setup:
    • Removed untracked .RData and .Rhistory from workspace root.
    • Deleted obsolete tests/figs/ directory (39 stale pre-vdiffr-1.0 SVGs).
    • Modernized .Rbuildignore (added ^\.RData$, ^\.Rhistory$, ^netlify\.toml$; fixed ^NEWS\.md$; dropped Travis/AppVeyor; retained ^docs$).
    • Created netlify.toml configured for publish = "docs".
    • Created .github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml for automated Netlify deployment.
    • Added .github/dependabot.yml for automated GitHub Actions dependency updates.
  • Task 0.2: Full Bug Remediation (All 19 Bugs Resolved):
    • BUG-01: Fixed vdist_xax scaling in R/vdist-data-prep.R to span mean ± 4 * sd.
    • BUG-02: Fixed fperc_data_prep adaptive upper x-axis bound when quantile >4.0> 4.0.
    • BUG-03: Fixed tprob_data_prep negative percentile crash using max(5, abs(perc) + 1).
    • BUG-04: Wired xaxis_range to shaded polygon in cplot_data_prep.
    • BUG-05: Guarded F theoretical standard deviation against den_df <= 4 division-by-zero (fsd <- NA_real_ and safe annotation offsets).
    • BUG-06: Fixed color mapping and annotation coordinate alignment in tprob_plot_build(type = "both").
    • BUG-07: Fixed check_positive validation condition (val <= 0) to strictly reject 0 and negative inputs.
    • BUG-08: Corrected check_suggests message formatting before calling stop().
    • BUG-09: Reordered validation in vdist_binom_prob (check_numeric before check_range).
    • BUG-10: Replaced bitwise | with logical || in check_range.
    • BUG-11: Fixed swapped visual snapshot titles for Student’s t interval vs both in tests/testthat/test-visual.R.
    • BUG-12: Stripped unprompted available.packages() CRAN network polling and magrittr pipe from R/zzz.R; preserved rotating static tips.
    • BUG-13: Fixed vdist_xaxp ignoring sd scaling (mean ± span).
    • BUG-14: Fixed binomial upper tail shading to strictly highlight x≥sx \ge s.
    • BUG-15: Replaced exact binomial density float equality with integer matching x==sx == s.
    • BUG-16: Corrected Student’s t upper-tail inverted text annotation colors in tprob_plot_build.
    • BUG-17: Added missing check_positive() degrees of freedom validation across vdist-t.R, vdist-f.R, and vdist-chisquare.R.
    • BUG-18: Clamped non-negative support (x≥0x \ge 0) on normal overlays in F distribution.
    • BUG-19: Expanded vdist_binom_perc quantile input range check_range(tp, 0, 1).
  • Task 0.3: Dependency & Namespace Refactor:
    • Removed magrittr from DESCRIPTION and NAMESPACE.
    • Bumped to Depends: R (>= 4.1.0).
    • Replaced @import utils with explicit @importFrom utils menu install.packages packageVersion.
  • Task 0.4: Documentation, Man Pages & Vignette Rectification:
    • Added explicit @return blocks to all 16 exported functions.
    • Fixed swapped @param p / @param tp roxygen documentation in R/vdist-binomial.R.
    • Fixed inverted example comments in R/vdist-f.R.
    • Renamed topic in R/vdist-t.R to vdist_t_plot for consistency across all distribution families.
    • Fixed all 5 pedagogical and numerical discrepancies in vignettes/introduction-to-vistributions.Rmd.
    • Standardized chunk options to fig.align = 'center'.
    • Regenerated NAMESPACE and man/*.Rd via devtools::document().
    • Rebuilt full pkgdown website in docs/ via pkgdown::build_site().

2026-09-08

Completed Today

  • Codebase Technical Audit:
